question: Will a woman win the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, or Economics?
note: Med (Deisseroth/Hegemann/Nagel), Phys (Halzen), Chem (Kagan/Soai) all men per CNN/NPR/RSC; reduces to P(woman among Econ laureates Oct 12). Econ base 3/17 since 2009; Clarivate 2026 econ picks Winter/Woodford/Varian/Athey (1 woman).

question: Will the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize be awarded (in whole or in part) to an organization?
note: Org share of Peace prizes 2012-2025 ~7/14; favourites list (Sudan ERR, Save Ukraine, Save the Children, ICC/ICJ, MSF) org-heavy vs individuals (Nakate, Navalnaya, Trump). Announced Oct 9 09:00Z.

question: Will at least one US citizen be awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics?
note: US citizen in ~15/16 econ prizes 2010-2025 (2014 Tirole the miss); all 4 Clarivate 2026 econ picks US-based. Narcissist-contest panel resolution adds small ambiguity. Edge ~0.03 < 0.04.

question: Will Chris Hipkins lead the NZ Labour Party to the next election (probably 2026)?
note: NZ election set Nov 7 2026 (Luxon announcement, AAP); Hipkins endorsed by caucus, leading Labour election team (Waatea Jun 2026). Leader swap <4 weeks out is rare (Ardern 2017 was ~7.5 weeks out).
